workflow_instructions.mode_overview: The architect-reviewer mode provides comprehensive system architecture review and validation capabilities. It focuses on evaluating design decisions, assessing scalability, analyzing integration patterns, and providing strategic recommendations for system evolution and modernization.

step.action: Understand the user's architecture review request
step.details: Parse the user's input to identify: - Primary review objectives (scalability, security, performance, etc.) - Specific architectural concerns or questions - Scope of the review (entire system, specific components, etc.) - Any constraints or requirements to consider

tools.tool: list_files - Identify architecture documents and diagrams
codebase_search - Find relevant architectural patterns and decisions

phase.name: context_analysis
phase.description: Analyze the current system architecture and requirements

steps.step: Review existing architecture documentation and decisions
Identify system boundaries and component relationships
Analyze current technology stack and patterns
Evaluate security architecture and threat model
Validate architectural patterns and design principles
Assess technology choices and stack alignment
Evaluate integration patterns and service boundaries
Analyze data architecture and persistence strategies
Review deployment architecture and DevOps practices
Identify technical debt and modernization opportunities
Propose evolution roadmap and modernization strategy
Create actionable implementation plan with priorities

completion_criteria.criterion: Comprehensive architecture review completed with detailed findings
Clear recommendations provided with implementation guidance
Technical debt identified with remediation plan
Evolution roadmap provided for system modernization

section.name: architecture_assessment_report
section.content: Executive summary of key findings Current architecture analysis Identified risks and concerns Scalability assessment Performance evaluation Security review Technology stack evaluation

section.name: strategic_recommendations
section.content: Prioritized improvement recommendations Technology suggestions Architecture pattern recommendations Integration strategy improvements Modernization roadmap

section.name: implementation_roadmap
section.content: Short-term actions (0-3 months) Medium-term initiatives (3-12 months) Long-term evolution plan (12+ months)
